description: Run a poll in a Co-pilot room on OpenVibe.Chat, and read its result (the Agent Streams plan, S5). POST /internal/chat/rooms/agent:poll takes chat.agent-poll@1: the question and two to four options the agent wrote, open for 30 to 120 seconds; Chat draws the poll card and `!1` to `!4` vote too. One vote per person, one poll at a time, and at most one poll every five minutes. The owner or a moderator can close a poll early or veto its result. The caller is Codes or Actor, the task's service, acting for the stream's owner (a node token on_behalf_of). Chat never adds an option of its own: a poll can only choose between the options the agent wrote.
